scripts.dev: npm run build -w @velament/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @velament/shared" "npm run dev -w @velament/backend" "npm run dev -w @velament/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @velament/shared && npm run build -w @velament/backend && npm run build -w @velament/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @velament/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @velament/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
